Approved findings

Approved evidence · As of 10 Nov 2026

The Data Provenance Initiative: A Large Scale Audit of Dataset Licensing & Attribution in AI (2310.16787v1) · paper method: The initial audit covers 44 instruction/alignment finetuning collections comprising 1,858 individual datasets selected by experts for widespread use; overlapping datasets are intentionally not deduplicated to preserve collection design choices.

Approved evidence · As of 10 Nov 2026

The Data Provenance Initiative: A Large Scale Audit of Dataset Licensing & Attribution in AI (2310.16787v1) · paper method: The license protocol searches for creator-attributable licenses explicitly applying to data, distinguishes them from code licenses, and records permitted-use, attribution and share-alike categories with the strictest feature across multiple licenses.

Approved evidence · As of 10 Nov 2026

The Data Provenance Initiative: A Large Scale Audit of Dataset Licensing & Attribution in AI (2310.16787v1) · paper method: The provenance audit combines linked public metadata, human legal-expert annotation and GPT-4-assisted annotation; its topic annotation uses GPT-4 on a sample of 100 examples for up to 10 topics.

The Data Provenance Initiative: A Large Scale Audit of Dataset Licensing & Attribution in AI (2310.16787v1) · paper method: The authors explicitly characterize their collection as best-effort categorization of self-reported licenses for research/transparency, not legal advice or a determination that the listed licenses are enforceable.
